title: bc → because (a rejection, published on purpose)
problem: bc → because (a rejection, published on purpose)
rationale: The naive intuition — shorten a frequent word — is the weakest kind of change. Included to demonstrate that Ainglish rejects things, evidence-first, and publishes the rejection.
example_ainglish: It failed bc the gate never fired.
example_english: It failed because the gate never fired.
predicted_measurement: Saves ~1 token; expected to LOSE on robustness-under-noise (a dropped/garbled "bc" is unrecoverable where "because" self-corrects). Refuted if robustness does not fall.
